name: Malton Berhad
overview: Malton Berhad 今年通过全资子公司 Bukit Rimau Development Sdn Bhd 以 RM97,225,800 收购柔佛新山一幅约 3.72 英亩的永久发展地皮，用于物业发展。其他业务板块今年没有公告披露具体动态。
overview_en: Malton Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Bukit Rimau Development Sdn Bhd, acquired approximately 3.72 acres of freehold development land in Johor Bahru for RM97,225,800 for property development. No specific updates were announced for the other business segments this year.

segments.name: 物业发展
segments.note: 今年通过子公司收购柔佛新山一幅发展地皮，扩大土地储备。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment expanded its land bank through a subsidiary's acquisition of a development land parcel in Johor Bahru.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Bukit Rimau Development Sdn Bhd 以 RM97,225,800 收购柔佛新山一幅约 3.72 英亩的永久发展地皮。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Bukit Rimau Development Sdn Bhd acquired approximately 3.72 acres of freehold development land in Johor Bahru for RM97,225,800.
